title: The Body page draws every weigh-in ever logged at once
what: The History list under the body weight or measurement graph shows every entry the member and the gym ever recorded, all drawn in one go, and the whole list is read again each time the page comes back into view. A member who weighs in daily has about 365 rows after a year and over 1,000 after three, so the page gets slower to open and scroll over time. Not timed on a real phone.
expected: The newest entries show first, a page at a time with a Show more button, as the exercise History tab already does.
who: members who log body weight often
how_often: every time the Body page opens, worse each month
fix_line: Show the newest 30 entries and add a Show more button

items.reason: These are native phone screens, not web pages; the only flagged web page in this family (the invite link page, CLS 0.109, 491 KiB) is built from the dashboard web folder, not this area
No watch code in these phone screens; the watch app is a separate area
